svg.text: Agent architecture: memory, GraphRAG, and the LLMOps loop
One request flows through working memory, hybrid retrieval (vector + graph + SQL), the agent loop, and a continuous eval and release cycle.
AI agent run: everything inside this dashed box is ephemeral
picks the right lookup per question: vector for similarity, graph for relationships, SQL for recency
Local: fan out from one entity
returns the evidence path, not just text,
so eval can check the reasoning
which hop or step broke, and why?
improved system prompt + config flows back into the next run
